profile.name: Wasatch 光谱仪设备封装组件
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于在控制器与 Wasatch 光谱仪采集线程之间建立队列通信。它负责连接底层设备对象、等待或轮询光谱仪设置、转发参数变更、接收光谱读数与状态消息，并管理断开与重置流程，常用于光谱数据采集界面的异步控制。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component that mediates queue-based communication between a controller and a Wasatch spectrometer acquisition thread. It connects the low-level device object, waits for or polls spectrometer settings, forwards setting changes, receives spectra and status messages, and manages reset and disconnect flow for asynchronous spectroscopy control.
